title: Pitch
description: Serialized form of a Pitch. CANONICAL (stripped) form is {swara, raised, oct, logOffset}. `ratios` and `fundamental` are NOT part of the canonical form — they are supplied at load time from the enclosing raga context. They MAY appear here only in LEGACY data; when present, an implementation must honor threaded context over embedded values (context wins).

swara.description: Scale degree 0-6 (sa, re, ga, ma, pa, dha, ni). Always serialized as an integer, never a string.

raised.description: Whether the swara is raised (suddha / tivra for ma). Forced true for sa (0) and pa (4).

oct.description: Octave relative to center sa. Integer, may be negative.

logOffset.description: Microtonal log2 offset applied on top of the raga ratio. Defaults to 0.

ratios.description: LEGACY ONLY. Stratified ratio array inherited from the raga. Omitted in canonical form. If present, treated as fallback context only.

fundamental.description: LEGACY ONLY. Center-sa frequency in Hz, inherited from the raga. Omitted in canonical form. If present, treated as fallback context only.
